4use crate::third_party::vello_common::fearless_simd::*;
5use crate::third_party::vello_common::util::Div255Ext;
6use crate::third_party::vello_cpu::fine::Splat4thExt;
7use crate::third_party::vello_cpu::peniko::{BlendMode, Compose};
8use crate::third_party::vello_cpu::util::NormalizedMulExt;
9
10pub(crate) trait ComposeExt {
11    fn compose<S: Simd>(&self, simd: S, src_c: u8x32<S>, bg_c: u8x32<S>, alpha_mask: Option<u8x32<S>>) -> u8x32<S>;
12}
13
14impl ComposeExt for BlendMode {
15    fn compose<S: Simd>(&self, simd: S, src_c: u8x32<S>, bg_c: u8x32<S>, alpha_mask: Option<u8x32<S>>) -> u8x32<S> {
16        let mut res = match self.compose {
17            Compose::SrcOver => SrcOver::compose(simd, src_c, bg_c),
18            Compose::Clear => Clear::compose(simd, src_c, bg_c),
19            Compose::Copy => Copy::compose(simd, src_c, bg_c),
20            Compose::DestOver => DestOver::compose(simd, src_c, bg_c),
21            Compose::Dest => Dest::compose(simd, src_c, bg_c),
22            Compose::SrcIn => SrcIn::compose(simd, src_c, bg_c),
23            Compose::DestIn => DestIn::compose(simd, src_c, bg_c),
24            Compose::SrcOut => SrcOut::compose(simd, src_c, bg_c),
25            Compose::DestOut => DestOut::compose(simd, src_c, bg_c),
26            Compose::SrcAtop => SrcAtop::compose(simd, src_c, bg_c),
27            Compose::DestAtop => DestAtop::compose(simd, src_c, bg_c),
28            Compose::Xor => Xor::compose(simd, src_c, bg_c),
29            Compose::Plus => Plus::compose(simd, src_c, bg_c),
30            // Have not been able to find a formula for this, so just fallback to Plus.
31            Compose::PlusLighter => Plus::compose(simd, src_c, bg_c),
32        };
33
34        if let Some(alpha_mask) = alpha_mask {
35            let alpha_mask_inv = 255 - alpha_mask;
36            let p1 = simd.widen_u8x32(alpha_mask) * simd.widen_u8x32(res);
37            let p2 = simd.widen_u8x32(alpha_mask_inv) * simd.widen_u8x32(bg_c);
38            res = simd.narrow_u16x32((p1 + p2).div_255());
39        }
40
41        res
42    }
43}
44
45macro_rules! compose {
46    ($name:ident, $fa:expr, $fb:expr, $sat:expr) => {
47        struct $name;
48
49        impl $name {
50            fn compose<S: Simd>(simd: S, src_c: u8x32<S>, bg_c: u8x32<S>) -> u8x32<S> {
51                let al_b = bg_c.splat_4th();
52                let al_s = src_c.splat_4th();
53
54                let fa = $fa(simd, al_s, al_b);
55                let fb = $fb(simd, al_s, al_b);
56
57                if $sat {
58                    simd.narrow_u16x32(
59                        (simd.widen_u8x32(src_c.normalized_mul(fa)) + simd.widen_u8x32(fb.normalized_mul(bg_c)))
60                            .min(u16x32::splat(simd, 255))
61                            .max(u16x32::splat(simd, 0)),
62                    )
63                } else {
64                    src_c.normalized_mul(fa) + fb.normalized_mul(bg_c)
65                }
66            }
67        }
68    };
69}
70
71compose!(Clear, |simd, _, _| u8x32::splat(simd, 0), |simd, _, _| u8x32::splat(simd, 0), false);
72compose!(Copy, |simd, _, _| u8x32::splat(simd, 255), |simd, _, _| u8x32::splat(simd, 0), false);
73compose!(SrcOver, |simd, _, _| u8x32::splat(simd, 255), |_, al_s: u8x32<S>, _| 255 - al_s, false);
74compose!(DestOver, |_, _, al_b: u8x32<S>| 255 - al_b, |simd, _, _| u8x32::splat(simd, 255), false);
75compose!(Dest, |simd, _, _| u8x32::splat(simd, 0), |simd, _, _| u8x32::splat(simd, 255), false);
76compose!(Xor, |_, _, al_b: u8x32<S>| 255 - al_b, |_, al_s: u8x32<S>, _| 255 - al_s, false);
77compose!(SrcIn, |_, _, al_b: u8x32<S>| al_b, |simd, _, _| u8x32::splat(simd, 0), false);
78compose!(DestIn, |simd, _, _| u8x32::splat(simd, 0), |_, al_s: u8x32<S>, _| al_s, false);
79compose!(SrcOut, |_, _, al_b: u8x32<S>| 255 - al_b, |simd, _, _| u8x32::splat(simd, 0), false);
80compose!(DestOut, |simd, _, _| u8x32::splat(simd, 0), |_, al_s: u8x32<S>, _| 255 - al_s, false);
81compose!(SrcAtop, |_, _, al_b: u8x32<S>| al_b, |_, al_s: u8x32<S>, _| 255 - al_s, false);
82compose!(DestAtop, |_, _, al_b: u8x32<S>| 255 - al_b, |_, al_s: u8x32<S>, _| al_s, false);
83compose!(Plus, |simd, _, _| u8x32::splat(simd, 255), |simd, _, _| u8x32::splat(simd, 255), true);
